semantics.installation: Declared is a named dependency; installed is a local or explicitly sourced parent observation. Neither proves readiness.
semantics.schema: Discovered means a callable argument schema was visible. Unknown means not inspected or not exposed.
semantics.probe: Passed, failed, auth-required, or unknown, with the tested scope and source preserved. A catalog response is not authenticated analysis.
semantics.execution: Tested is limited to the named action; parent-tested remains separately attributed. No biological execution was tested.
semantics.scientificAcceptance: Not-assessed throughout this registry. Independent scientific review is separate from tool access, checksums, and software tests.
semantics.imports: Imported receipts always remain unverified. Claimed success is a claim, not accepted execution evidence.
semantics.review: Confirmation checkboxes are transient local review state, bound to one plan hash. They never authorize terminal, MCP, account, compute, or publication actions.

stages.name: Versioned NCBI genome panel
stages.description: Accession versions and a panel manifest must fix the selected genomes. The inherited panel describes 177 LAB genomes and approximately 110 named species; Enterococcus is excluded.
stages.acceptance: Panel manifest with accession.version and checksum; no rows supplied.

stages.name: Annotated proteins
stages.description: Preserve assembly, annotation version, protein identifiers, and provenance before either branch begins.
stages.acceptance: Protein annotation provenance tied to the versioned panel; no sequences supplied.

stages.name: Conserved single-copy marker families
stages.description: Identify conserved single-copy marker families with explicit family definitions and copy-count review.
stages.acceptance: Family membership, copy-count QC, tool and database versions.

stages.name: Independent alignments
stages.description: Align each marker family independently. Record trimming parameters and inspect each alignment.
stages.acceptance: Per-family alignments, trimming decisions, and QC.

stages.name: Concatenation
stages.description: Join reviewed marker alignments in a recorded order and retain partition boundaries.
stages.acceptance: Concatenated alignment plus marker order and partitions.

stages.name: IQ-TREE host phylogeny
stages.description: Infer the host phylogeny only from the marker alignment. Record model, partitions, support procedure, seed, and version.
stages.acceptance: Tree and run provenance with independent scientific review.

stages.name: Geneious export
stages.description: Export the reviewed host phylogeny for downstream presentation. Keep tip identifiers mapped to the panel.
stages.acceptance: Reviewed export and tip-to-panel identifier mapping.

stages.name: Ordered proteins and coordinates
stages.description: Retain protein order and genomic coordinates for locus interpretation, independently of tree inference.
stages.acceptance: Ordered protein IDs, contig IDs, strand, and coordinates.

stages.name: DefenseFinder
stages.description: Run candidate detection only against explicitly versioned protein and coordinate inputs.
stages.acceptance: Candidate output plus tool, model, and input provenance.

stages.name: Complete versus unreviewed hits
stages.description: Separate hits described as complete by the method from unreviewed candidates. Complete does not mean scientifically accepted.
stages.acceptance: Separate candidate categories with method criteria; no counts supplied.

stages.name: Manual locus review
stages.description: Review candidate loci and context manually. Missing or unreviewed evidence is not an absence call.
stages.acceptance: Locus decisions, reviewer rationale, and source evidence.

stages.name: Four reviewed R-M rings
stages.description: Present Type I, Type II (including IIG), Type III, and Type IV annotations against the host tree. Rings encode reviewed annotation, not a separate inferred tree.
stages.acceptance: Four reviewed annotation tracks linked to the host export; no R-M states supplied.
